statement: A frozen, checksummed, reproducible research-instrument baseline: a specific commit of the server, the frontend, the analytical registry, the Category-9 and lineage layer, the participant workflow and the deployment configuration, with every production file discovered from the deployed tree and hashed, and with the controlling supervisory specification pinned by an executable guard for the first time.

It is NOT a claim of validated analytical performance. No module in this instrument has been validated against a labelled corpus of project outcomes or an expert reference standard, because neither exists yet; that is Study A in the praxis two-study architecture and it is a research programme, not an engineering task. Of the hundred scientific targets, three are SCIENTIFIC_PASS. The remaining ninety-seven carry truthful lesser dispositions and the freeze records them as they are.

That the instrument computes what its committed specification says it computes, in the ways Run 20 qualified; that the website presents that truthfully, as Run 21 qualified; that the participant protocol is enforced server-side; that exactly two modules vote; that eight concept-only modules and Material Cost Variance are disabled and cannot compute; and that this exact baseline is reproducible from a clean checkout of a named commit.

That any module is empirically accurate. That any module output is a regulatory determination -- ninety-nine of a hundred targets are explicitly NOT_A_REGULATORY_DETERMINATION and the hundredth is REGULATORY_VERSION_BLOCKED. That module accuracy is a participant-facing property; the praxis constraints forbid it explicitly.

100 targets: 96 registered project modules (registry groups A, B and C) minus Material Cost Variance A3.4 which is excluded from the active scientific population, giving 95 project targets, plus 5 portfolio targets (group D). 100 unique canonical identifiers. Derived from the registry at release time, not copied from a report.
Exactly 2, derived from registry.CORE_VOTING_MODULES = {A1.7 TCPI, A1.8 Variance at Completion}. Proved red by a mutation adding a third.

9 modules the server refuses to execute: 8 concept-only (A3.8, B2.7, B2.9, B2.20, B4.1, B4.2, B4.5, B4.6) plus Material Cost Variance A3.4, held separately because it is disabled pending an evidence-design decision and is NOT classified as algorithmically invalid. Concept-only ACTIVATION is 0.

CANONICAL ID A3.4. The owner's prompt calls it 'Material Cost Variance 3.4'; 3.4 is not its canonical identifier and its old_id is in fact 3.5. The standing programme rule that p0-baseline/module_renumbering_map.csv's old_id column is not canonical identity is applied here: the module is identified as A3.4 throughout.

UNCHANGED. evidence -> preliminary response and confidence -> server lock -> AI reveal -> final response, confidence, disposition, evidence and rationale -> server final lock -> next valid period or assignment. No randomisation, stage order, condition or assignment rule was altered by Run 22.

2, from the committed provisioning record and the locked praxis design. Run 22 additionally proved the transition machinery generalises to 3 (P1 -> P2 -> P3) so that a later advisor decision to raise the period count does not meet untested code. That is generalisation evidence about the instrument and is NOT a protocol claim.
Established by a clean isolated checkout of the release commit, rebuilt from committed configuration only, with the production and authority manifests verified and the complete suite re-run there.
